title: VanillaCircle
description: A modpack aiming to optimize the overall Minecraft expierience as much as possible while still maintaining a Vanillia feel.
body:
# VanillaCircle
### Looking for Minecraft with a little more spice? 
That’s what VanillaCircle is all about! This pack **adds lots of quality of life changes** and **cool terrain features,** but keeps the gameplay feeling familiar and relaxed.

You’ll find new useful features like **backpacks** that you can **fully customize**. They come in different tiers—from a simple one with 9 slots to an incredible netherite-tier backpack that **holds as much as a double chest!**

### Every dimension gets a fresh look:
 
<details>
<summary>The Overworld </summary>

is shaped by Tectonic, Terralith, and Geophilic, so exploring never gets boring.

</details>
<details>
<summary>The Nether</summary>

turns wild with Amplified Nether.

</details>
<details>
<summary>The End</summary>

Nullscape makes it way more interesting!

</details>

**This pack is for everyone** - whether you want to chill out and build in iron armor, or take on epic hardcore projects. With all the new biomes, there’s always **something new around the corner.**

Take your time, explore, and let the world surprise you! (trust me its worth it)

<3 stockkii
